enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the air conditioner running to stay cool during the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Stretch arm. Adjust pillow. Turn to back. Pull blanket down. Turn to left side. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, and taking a quick cool shower to start the hot day fresh
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open door. Turn on light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast with iced water and coffee before the early shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Open drawer. Take out spoon. Close drawer. Eat cereal. Drink iced water. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Put coffee in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Stir coffee. Drink coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing in light work clothes, checking the weather forecast, and packing a water bottle, lunch, and bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Open weather app. Check forecast. Put down phone. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water bottle. Fill water bottle. Take out lunch container. Place in bag. Put water bottle in bag. Zip bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital on public transport in the already building heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Place bag on lap. Look out window. Check phone. Get up. Walk to exit door. Exit bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital. Walk to staff room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a hospital physiotherapist: running morning rehabilitation sessions, assessing patients, and updating treatment notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to therapy room. Greet patient. Review patient chart. Ask patient to sit. Perform assessment. Ask patient to lift arm. Observe range of motion. Take notes. Instruct patient on exercise. Demonstrate exercise. Assist patient with exercise. Walk patient to next station. Repeat with next patient. Update treatment notes on computer. Walk to next patient. Assess mobility. Instruct on walking. Assist with walking. Document progress.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break in the hospital staff room, eating packed food and rehydrating
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to staff room. Open bag. Take out lunch box. Open lunch box. Take out fork. Eat food. Drink water. Refill water glass. Drink water. Close lunch box. Put lunch box in bag. Zip bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing physiotherapy work: afternoon patient sessions, mobility exercises, and handover documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to therapy room. Greet patient. Review patient chart. Ask patient to sit. Perform assessment. Ask patient to lift leg. Observe range of motion. Take notes. Instruct patient on exercise. Demonstrate exercise. Assist patient with exercise. Walk patient to next station. Repeat with next patient. Update handover documentation. Walk to next patient. Assess mobility. Instruct on walking. Assist with walking. Document progress. Walk to staff room.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home after the shift through the peak of the afternoon heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Place bag on lap. Look out window. Check phone. Get up. Walk to exit door. Exit bus. Walk to home. Enter home. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a light dinner using the induction cooker and refrigerator ingredients
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Plate food.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and drinking plenty of cold water
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat food. Drink water. Refill glass. Drink water. Eat more. Finish meal. Clear plate. Put plate in sink. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool evening shower and washing off the day's sweat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in the air-conditioned living room watching TV shows to unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on air conditioner. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Return to living room. Sit on couch. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer at the desk to review physiotherapy case notes and read professional articles
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Log in. Open case notes. Read. Scroll. Type notes. Open browser. Read article. Take notes. Close programs. Shut down computer. Turn off lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the kitchen, washing up, and preparing lunch and cold drinks for tomorrow
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Clear table. Wash dishes. Dry dishes. Put away dishes. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients for lunch. Prepare lunch. Put in container. Fill water bottle. Put in refrigerator. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: brushing teeth, washing face, and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open door. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on tap. Wash face. Turn off tap. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed with the air conditioner on, setting an alarm, and falling asleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on air conditioner. Adjust temperature. Sit on bed. Take off slippers. Lie down. Pull blanket. Set alarm on phone. Put phone on nightstand. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Sleep.
